details: Negotiations between the United States and Iran regarding a peace deal and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz have reached an impasse. US President Donald Trump responded with new demands on Monday, leading to a rhetorical escalation that is complicating efforts to reopen the crucial waterway. This geopolitical tension has pushed Brent crude futures near $90 a barrel and US crude futures to $82.52, their highest levels since July 31, exacerbating global inflation concerns. This situation is contributing to uncertainty around future Federal Reserve interest rate decisions, as higher energy costs tend to fuel inflation.
title: US-Iran Stalemate Drives Oil Prices Higher, Fuels Inflation Fears

details: Wells Fargo is advising investors to hedge against the upcoming July Consumer Price Index (CPI) report, as its sentiment indicator has hit its highest "sell" signal in over eight years. Analysts at the bank fear that a higher-than-expected CPI reading could shift the market narrative towards stagflation, particularly following last week's softer-than-expected jobs report. Such a scenario could prompt a rebound in expectations for Federal Reserve interest rate hikes.
title: Wells Fargo Warns of "Sell" Signal Ahead of July CPI Release

details: A group of UK lawmakers has warned that British banks' reluctance to provide services to cryptocurrency companies and investors poses one of the "single biggest barriers" to the growth of the country's digital assets industry. In a letter to the leaders of major UK banks, the parliamentary group cited "repeated instances" of crypto firms struggling to open bank accounts and facing transfer restrictions. Lawmakers argue this friction could undermine the success of the UK's forthcoming crypto regulatory regime, set to be introduced next year.
title: UK Banks Accused of Stunting Crypto Industry Growth

details: The US Senate Majority Leader moved on Saturday, August 8th, to advance the "Clarity Act," a significant bill aimed at creating a comprehensive regulatory framework for cryptocurrencies. If passed, this legislation would provide the crypto industry with its first federal rulebook, defining when digital tokens are considered securities or commodities and clarifying which regulators oversee them. The move, ahead of the Senate's August recess, could pave the way for a full floor vote in mid-September.
title: US Senate Advances Landmark Crypto Bill Before Recess

details: A joint Japan-US yen intervention, confirmed on August 3, 2026, saw the New York Fed sell euros (rather than dollars) to buy yen. Analysts have noted this as an unusual mechanic. This strategic intervention, intended to support the Japanese yen, is now understood to have implications that extend from the Treasury market to the broader crypto market, as currency interventions can introduce volatility and uncertainty across global financial systems.
title: Japan/US Yen Intervention: Implications for Treasury and Crypto Markets
